rationale: Record a test-registration change that crosses design-source-ingest through test/cmake/cli_import_tool_tests.cmake, design_import_native_codegen_tests.cmake, design_import_runtime_bridge_tests.cmake and design_import_tool_cli_tests.cmake, and visual-proof-harness through test/cmake/view_widget_bridge_tests.cmake. Each crossing line is a pulp_test_data(<suite> NO_DEFINE PATHS ...) call after an existing registration, declaring the checkout files the test already opens (test/fixtures/imports, test/fixtures/browser-capture-*, compat.json, core/view/src, and similar). NO_DEFINE leaves every compile definition unchanged; all build.ninja DEFINES/FLAGS lines are identical before and after. Test sources, capture, rendering, DesignIR, fixtures and thresholds are unchanged. Registered as watch-only so family coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
